newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office buys Disney unit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office buys Disney unit.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co. said Tuesday it bought Childcraft Education Corp. from a Walt Disney Co. unit for $14.6 million in cash.
Childcraft, which was sold by Disney Enterprises Inc., will be operated as a separate unit of U.S. Office Products' School Speciality Inc. subsidiary, it said.
School Speciality is the nation's largest distributor of school supply products, with annual sales of about $260 million, U.S. Office Products said.
Childcraft has annual revenues of about $25 million.
U.S. Office Products, based in Washington, said it has annual sales of $3.2 billion, with operations in the United States, New Zealand, Australia, Canada and Britain.
Its stock was unchanged at $24.375 on Nasdaq at mid-afternoon. Disney fell 25 cents to $83 on the New York Stock Exchange.
